**Daily Devotional**

**April 5**

*20 Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world? 21 For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe. (1 Corinthians 1:20-21 KJV)*

God’s wisdom is so far above that of man, that it is not even comparable (1 Corinthians 1:25). Man tends to think only in the physical realm with what they can sense with their five physical senses, but the spiritual realm must be seen by faith, through the spiritual eyes of our heart. The wise in this world, who know and believe only physical things, tend to not believe anything that they cannot ascertain with their five senses. For this reason God is unable to use most worldly wise men, as they cannot believe in anything that is spiritual. God says that they are fools (Psalms 14:1, 53:1).

Since carnal man just does not want to believe in God or anything spiritual, then God has chosen to save people by the foolishness of preaching. It is so true that the most educated people of this world have a hard time in comprehending anything spiritual, and being wise in the things of this world, they become stupid in spiritual matters. God can use only those that will believe in the things unseen in this universe, as those are the only ones that can have the faith to believe in our God (Hebrews 11:6), who is a spirit (John 4:24). Praise God that I was not so smart that I couldn’t believe in Him and be saved – Thank you Jesus.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
